root_cause_found: The tactics layer only runs under alarm = Sentinels7.threat(w, fac) != null, which needs CnFacility.secure_state(w, fac) != 'secure'. In test_tactics_drill 8 riflemen 7 tiles outside the north wall never made the facility insecure for 900 ticks (TACTICS: gaits [], stand-to jobs 0, only SentinelCheckIn events), and in the balance fights the wall turrets / towers killed the infantry and Machine waves before (or without) an alarm: Sentinels lost nobody and patrols kept checking in. Fix first: raise the alarm from the guard net too (any enemy the owner sees inside compound + net_r, i.e. compute threat() from _net-style contacts, not only secure_state), then rerun; the casualty drill already works without alarm (CASUALTY DRILL: SentinelMenderTreats 1) but SentinelCasualtyDrill did not fire because the chosen casualty's buddy was garrisoned / job differed - check _casualty_drill conditions with a field pair.
